subject: ENGLISH 9
pageTitle: How to Write a Thesis Statement: Claim and Reasons
description: Turn a topic into an arguable thesis statement with a claim and reasons, and learn what makes a thesis weak or strong, with two worked examples.
caption: Thesis statements in 7 swipes: topic vs claim, the formula, and two before-and-after examples. Save this for your next essay. Free English 9 study guide at precisstudy.com/english-9 (no sign-up).

slides.title: A TOPIC IS NOT A THESIS
THE FORMULA
slides.note: If no one could disagree, it is a fact, not a thesis.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Improve this: 'This essay is about The Odyssey.'
steps: That names a topic, not a claim
Ask: what does the story show?
slides.answer: In The Odyssey, Odysseus shows that perseverance matters more than strength because he survives through cleverness and loyalty to home.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Improve this: 'Social media has good and bad points.'
steps: It is vague and takes no side
slides.answer: Schools should limit phones in class because they distract students and reduce face-to-face discussion.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: A thesis that announces ('In this essay I will…')
points: Keep it specific enough to prove in a few paragraphs.
Revise it after you draft, if your evidence changes.
